svg.title: Modu Chanyu: Xiongnu sun and moon
svg.desc: Attested emblem. Gold sun disks and crescent moons decorate excavated Xiongnu elite coffins, including Tomb 64 at Takhiltiin Khotgor. The motif is archaeological; its use here as a banner is a game adaptation, not a verified flag of Modu. Colors follow the game palette, with darker banner ink where needed for contrast; not historical flag colors.
